chunks: And they were followed in this world by a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection. Beware! The 'Ad disbelieved in their Lord. Beware to the 'Ad, the people of Hud.
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of the tribe of 'Ad in this world and the hereafter according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the comprehensive nature of divine punishment, where the 'Ad tribe experienced tangible curses in their earthly existence before the ultimate spiritual ruin of the Hereafter. It serves as a paradigmatic example of how persistent arrogance and rejection of prophetic guidance lead to both historical decline and eternal separation from God's mercy.
